overviewParagraphs: Black Mountain Golf Club in Hua Hin is, quite simply, the benchmark for Thailand golf — and for many international ranking panels, the benchmark for Asian golf. Carved directly from a granite mountain on the outskirts of Hua Hin, the course offers visual drama and strategic depth in equal measure, with the natural rock formations, canyon-style valleys, and sweeping ridge views making every hole a genuine event.

At 7,375 yards from the back tees, Black Mountain is a genuine championship examination. The exposed granite boulders serve as both aesthetic masterstrokes and penalty-zone hazards, and the greens — fast, firm, and beautifully conditioned year-round — demand proper reading of the full hole before committing to an approach.

AGS considers Black Mountain essential on any Thailand golf itinerary. It is the course that consistently generates the most enthusiastic feedback from returning discerning clients — the combination of extraordinary visual setting, perfect conditioning, and genuine challenge is unmatched in the region.

curatorBriefHtml: Black Mountain Golf Club (opened 2007 by Phil Ryan, 25 minutes inland from Hua Hin) is Thailand’s undisputed modern tournament benchmark — host of multiple Asian Tour and European Tour co-sanctioned events and featuring 27 immaculate championship holes (East, West, and North nines; 7,375 yards Par 72 championship combination). Set beneath dramatic dark-granite hills, every fairway, creek hazard, and lightning-fast putting surface is maintained to European Tour standards year-round.

Having played Black Mountain personally, what elevates it above almost every resort course in Thailand is sheer consistency and drama: elevated tees launch drives into pristine valley corridors, water guards aggressive pins, and the slick, true greens test your touch on every hole. Compare it head-to-head with its Hua Hin rival in Black Mountain vs. Pineapple Valley (Banyan).

Black Mountain anchors our Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways and Royal Siam Circuit, pairing effortlessly with Pineapple Valley and Springfield Royal from luxury coastal bases like The Standard Hua Hin or V Villas Hua Hin.

scorecard.verdict: The jewel of Hua Hin and one of Asia's undisputed icons. Multiple European Tour venue featuring 27 holes carved into the foothills of Black Mountain. Fast, undulating greens, brilliant risk-reward design, and first-class clubhouse amenities.

faqs.q: Which two 9-hole loops are best among Black Mountain's 27 holes?
faqs.a: The original East and West nines form the classic Asian/European Tour championship 18 (featuring the dramatic island-style par-3 11th and creek-lined closing holes), while the newer North nine offers a superb third loop for a 27- or 36-hole visit.

faqs.q: How far is Black Mountain Golf Club from Hua Hin town and Bangkok?
faqs.a: Black Mountain is just 20–25 minutes inland from Hua Hin beachfront resorts, and roughly 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours south of Bangkok / Suvarnabhumi Airport via luxury private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: Should we play Black Mountain or Pineapple Valley if we only have time for one?
faqs.a: If forced to pick one, choose Black Mountain for unmatched tournament conditioning and dramatic mountain framing — though any 3- to 4-night Hua Hin trip easily fits both.

faqs.q: When is the prime season to play Black Mountain in Hua Hin?
faqs.a: Hua Hin enjoys one of Thailand’s driest climates: November through April is peak dry season (25–32°C), and even May–September sees far less rainfall than Phuket or Bangkok.
